# Image Sources

This directory contains static images used in the blog post.

All four were generated on 2026-09-07 with Google Gemini
(`gemini-3-pro-image-preview`), called directly through the
`gemini-image-generator` MCP server rather than through the web
interface, then resized to 1600px wide and converted to JPEG at
quality 85 with ImageMagick.

## hero.jpg

- **Source**: Generated with Gemini (`gemini-3-pro-image-preview`)
- **License**: Generated image, no external attribution required
- **Usage**: Hero image for blog post listing and opening
- **Prompt**: a hardbound book lying open on a pale wooden desk, its
  pages showing only the faint suggestion of two-column layout and
  small figures with nothing legible, a small brass padlock resting
  open and unlatched on the left-hand page, a red pencil lying across
  the right-hand page, soft natural light falling from the upper left,
  shallow depth of field with the open padlock sharp and the far edge
  of the desk falling out of focus, muted palette of paper white and
  graphite grey with a single warm brass accent. Metaphor: an open
  license unlocks the book and changes nothing about what is written
  inside it. Shot on a 50mm lens, editorial still life, no people, no
  logos, no readable text.
- **Date**: 2026-09-07

## ambiance1.jpg

- **Source**: Generated with Gemini (`gemini-3-pro-image-preview`)
- **License**: Generated image, no external attribution required
- **Usage**: Placed after the Objectives section
- **Prompt**: a tall leaning stack of very thick reference volumes on
  the left of a pale wooden desk and one slim open paperback lying
  flat on the right, a narrow green cloth bookmark trailing from the
  slim volume, cool morning light from a window behind and to the
  right, deep depth of field so both the stack and the slim volume
  stay sharp, muted palette of paper white and graphite grey with one
  muted green accent. Metaphor: the short book that matches a single
  course gets read, and the comprehensive doorstop only gets
  consulted. Shot on an 85mm lens, editorial still life, no people, no
  logos, no readable text.
- **Date**: 2026-09-07

## ambiance2.jpg

- **Source**: Generated with Gemini (`gemini-3-pro-image-preview`)
- **License**: Generated image, no external attribution required
- **Usage**: Placed before the Tips section
- **Prompt**: an extreme close view of a single textbook page showing
  a small hand-drawn diagram at the top and, immediately below it, a
  faint ruled answer box with light pencil working inside it, a
  mechanical pencil resting at the lower edge of the frame, warm
  overhead lighting, very shallow depth of field with the ruled answer
  box sharp and the diagram softening above it, muted palette of paper
  cream and graphite grey with one faint blue rule accent. Metaphor:
  the distance between a question and its answer is a design decision,
  and shorter is better. Shot on a macro lens, editorial still life,
  no people, no logos, no readable text.
- **Date**: 2026-09-07

## ambiance3.jpg

- **Source**: Generated with Gemini (`gemini-3-pro-image-preview`)
- **License**: Generated image, no external attribution required
- **Usage**: Placed before the Lessons Learned section
- **Prompt**: a slim print-on-demand paperback resting face-down on
  top of a closed silver laptop on a pale wooden desk, a pair of
  reading glasses folded beside them, late-afternoon window light
  raking in from the left and casting a long soft shadow, deep depth
  of field holding both the book and the laptop edge sharp, muted
  palette of paper white, graphite grey and warm amber late light.
  Metaphor: the same book delivered on a screen and on paper, because
  a meaningful minority of readers still want paper. Shot on a 50mm
  lens, lifestyle photography, no people, no logos, no readable text.
- **Date**: 2026-09-07
